definition: jobs = maximal runs of one non-empty orderId per AGV (kept_messages), duration = ts of the first later message with another orderId minus the job's first ts; see the module docstring of fleet/duration_spread.py
deviations: Truth source: the operator brief said truth from truth.json, but truth.json holds no stuck episodes (only floor, blocked, outage and frozen windows; closed-loop-sticky's is the v1 file). The truth used is the stuck-episode definition of fleet_analyser/score.py (benchmark.json batch.score.truth_definition): score._load + score._truth_runs, kept when end - start >= 30. fleet/truth.py is not imported.

Message sets differ: jobs read timebudget.kept_messages (sorted by (ts, header_id), a message whose ts <= the previous kept ts is dropped, duplicate (serial, headerId) and rejected lines dropped by read_messages); the truth episodes read score._load over every raw line (drops nothing, pickers included). dropped_by_kept_messages counts the messages kept_messages dropped per zone (AGVs only).
Denominator: robot_hours of the deadlock file includes the pickers (12 robots x shift on the medium map) for both blocking and truth, so the two columns share a scale.
The statistics read a different robot set (AGVs) than the truth column (all robots of the zone, score_run's rule).

No per-seed incremental write or resume: the run reads existing streams only and writes one file (--out) at the end; the CLAUDE.md long-run rule applies to simulators, and nothing besides --out may be written here.
notes: At n = 10 zones a Spearman rho near 0.65 is about the p < 0.05 line (two-sided); at n = 30 about 0.36.
Agreement is per run only. The median over runs is over decided runs; a pair with no decided run has null medians.
'blocking' always means zones[z].blocked_s_per_robot_hour of the -sb deadlock file, not the blocking_cluster / blocking_chain objects.
cv uses the population standard deviation (ddof = 0).
All thresholds of the verdict are ours, set in docs/LITERATURE.md Part 8 before the run.

verdict.s15b_line: **S15B.** Commodity if, for either decisive statistic, the median over runs of ρ(statistic, blocking number) is ≥ 0.7 with median top-3 overlap ≥ 2/3, **or** ρ(statistic, truth) ≥ ρ(blocking, truth) in at least 3 of the decided runs. **Supports the lead** only if both decisive statistics have median ρ with the blocking number < 0.4 **and** the blocking number beats both on truth in at least 4 of 5 runs. Anything else is reported as mixed. All thresholds are ours, set here before the run.
